issues.description: The Person entity's id field type is inconsistent between the template, the solution, and the repository definitions. In the template Person.java the id field is declared as Long, and PersonRepository is parameterized with Long as the entity ID type. In the solution Person.java the private field is declared as Integer while the getter and setter methods (getId/setId) still use Long. This mismatch (Integer field vs Long accessor types and repository generic) will cause compilation errors and prevents students from running or testing the project as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.id field type consistent with the repository and accessors. Change the field declaration in solution_repository/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java from 'private Integer id;' to 'private Long id;' (or alternatively change the repository and accessor signatures to Integer across all files). The preferred fix is to use Long for the id field to match the template and PersonRepository's generic type.
